pluginDescription: Independently toggleable desktop and mobile enhancements for SiYuan; every setting item can be enabled, disabled or hidden on its own.
panel.none: No setting item is visible right now. Check feature-control.json at the repository root.
panel.readonlyTip: SiYuan is in read-only or publish mode, so settings cannot be saved.
dialog.discardText: You have unsaved changes. Closing now discards them.
feature.modalBlur.name: Blur behind modals
feature.modalBlur.desc: Applies a backdrop blur to the dialog scrim so the editor behind it is softened while the dialog itself stays sharp.
feature.docTreeOpenedAccent.name: Accent for the opened note
feature.docTreeOpenedAccent.desc: Draws a flush accent bar on the left edge of the currently opened note in the document tree, with a customisable colour.
docTreeOpenedAccent.colorTip: Leave empty to follow the SiYuan theme primary; any CSS colour such as #rrggbb, rgb() or var(--b3-theme-primary) works
feature.mobileSidebarBlur.name: Blur behind mobile side panels
feature.mobileSidebarBlur.desc: Makes the mobile side panels translucent and blurred, so the document behind them is softened.
feature.mobileDockBlur.name: Blur behind the mobile dock bar
feature.mobileDockBlur.desc: Turns the floating mobile dock bar into frosted glass so the document blurs underneath while scrolling.
feature.mobileBarAnimation.name: Smoother mobile bars
feature.mobileBarAnimation.desc: Adds a smooth transition to the show/hide behaviour of the mobile top bar, breadcrumb and floating dock bar; the dock bar only switches between fully shown and fully hidden instead of stopping half faded and half scrolled out.
feature.mobileSyncButton.name: Always show Sync on mobile
feature.mobileSyncButton.desc: Keeps the Sync button visible in the mobile top-right corner; the click behaviour stays SiYuan's own sync guide.
feature.hideMobileExit.name: Hide the mobile Quit button
feature.hideMobileExit.desc: Hides the icon-only Quit button in the mobile side panel.
feature.codeBlockLangEmpty.name: Never remember the code language
feature.codeBlockLangEmpty.desc: New code blocks always start with an empty language instead of reusing the language picked last time.
feature.dailyNoteDirect.name: Create the daily note directly
feature.dailyNoteDirect.desc: Skips the notebook prompt when creating a daily note and uses the notebook chosen below; creation itself still goes through SiYuan's own flow.
dailyNoteDirect.notebookTip: Only currently opened notebooks are listed; choosing None keeps SiYuan's own prompt
feature.firstDocIcon.name: Fixed first document icon
feature.firstDocIcon.desc: Uses the emoji below the first time a document gets an icon instead of a random one; the emoji picker still opens so it can be changed.
firstDocIcon.emojiTip: Enter a single emoji; leave empty to go back to a random icon
feature.externalLinkConfirm.name: Confirm before opening a web link
feature.externalLinkConfirm.desc: Asks before opening an http/https link and shows the full original URL, so nothing is opened until it is confirmed.
externalLinkConfirm.title: Open this external link?
externalLinkConfirm.prompt: The following link will be opened in your browser:
feature.kernelReconnectButton.name: Reconnect button on the disconnect panel (experimental)
feature.kernelReconnectButton.desc: Adds a Reconnect button to the kernel-disconnected panel: it probes whether the kernel is back and, if so, reloads the frontend to rebuild the connection.
kernelReconnectButton.label: Reconnect now
kernelReconnectButton.offline: The kernel is still unreachable; please try again in a moment.
feature.kernelAutoReconnect.name: Automatic reconnect after a disconnect (experimental)
feature.kernelAutoReconnect.desc: When the kernel connection drops, probes the kernel using the count and interval below and reloads the frontend as soon as it answers, instead of waiting for SiYuan's own 3-second retry.
kernelAutoReconnect.attemptsTip: Set to 0 to disable automatic attempts
feature.mobileRefPanelHeight.name: Taller mobile candidate panel
feature.mobileRefPanelHeight.desc: Raises the height of the mobile candidate panel used for reference search and friends to a share of the viewport, never past the bottom of the visible area.
mobileRefPanelHeight.maxHeightTip: Share of the viewport height; the real height is still capped by the space between the panel and the bottom of the screen
feature.mobileTabDocIcon.name: Default document icon in the mobile tab overview
feature.mobileTabDocIcon.desc: Chooses whether documents without an icon show the SVG placeholder, an emoji, or follow SiYuan's own 'use SVG icon' file-tree setting.
feature.mobileSelectNative.name: Native SiYuan style for mobile dropdowns
feature.mobileSelectNative.desc: Opening a dropdown on mobile shows SiYuan's own menu instead of the WebView picker, and still fires change on selection.
feature.mobileLongpressMenuLabel.name: Labels in the mobile long-press menu
feature.mobileLongpressMenuLabel.desc: Adds text to the icon-only copy and paste buttons in the mobile long-press menu, using SiYuan's own menu item styling.
feature.mobileBlockIconAlways.name: Keep the block icon visible on mobile
feature.mobileBlockIconAlways.desc: While a block is being operated on mobile its block icon no longer flickers: it is put back the moment the kernel clears it, and clicking it still opens the native menu.
feature.inlineCodeCopy.name: Copy button for inline code
feature.inlineCodeCopy.desc: Adds a copy button to inline code, shown on hover, always, or not at all.
inlineCodeCopy.label: Copy inline code
feature.commandPanelSlim.name: Slimmer desktop command panel
feature.commandPanelSlim.desc: Shrinks the desktop command panel to a share of SiYuan's native width (50% by default) so it covers less of the document.
commandPanelSlim.widthTip: Share of SiYuan's native width (80vw); 50% equals 40vw
feature.codeSnippetHighlight.name: Syntax highlighting for snippets
feature.codeSnippetHighlight.desc: Colours the snippet editor under Settings using CSS/JS syntax, with SiYuan's own highlight.js and the currently selected code theme, so it follows theme changes.
feature.mobileConsoleLog.name: Console log viewer
feature.mobileConsoleLog.desc: Mobile has no developer console: this collects console output from the moment the plugin loads and shows the full log in a dialog from the button below.
mobileConsoleLog.capacityTip: The oldest entries are dropped once this is exceeded
mobileConsoleLog.openTip: The dialog lets you read every entry, copy the whole log, or clear it
mobileConsoleLog.title: Console log
